newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA HAD $9.861 BLN FOREIGN DEBT END - SEPTEMBER.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA HAD $9.861 BLN FOREIGN DEBT END - SEPTEMBER.

text.p: Bulgaria's foreign debt totalled
$9.861 billion at end-September, up from $9.307 billion at
end-June, preliminary central bank figures showed.
The Bulgarian National Bank (BNB) said it had started to
calculate the debt according to World Bank guidelines.
Foreign debts of commercial banks, non-residents' deposits
in Bulgarian banks and debts of local legal entities to
non-residents approved by the finance ministry were now
included in the total debt, a BNB statement said.
Interest and maturity payments due on lev-denominated
government securities, which were issued to finance the budget
deficict and were bought by non-residents now were also part of
the total debt, the statement said.
Revised figures put foreign debt at $10.513 billion at the
end of last year, up from previous $9.446 billion. The BNB said
it based its calculation on World Bank's Debtor Reporting
System Manual, 1989.
Debt structure has considerably changed since 1991 when
total debt stood at $12.301 billion as long term debt with
maturity over one year rose to 86.7 percent of the total in
Septebmer from 21.8 percent in 1991, the BNB said.
This was due to a rise of long term debt to the
International Monetary Fund, the World Bank, the European
Union, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and
the European Investment Bank and the Paris Club of government
creditors, the BNB said.
Short term debt with maturity of up to one year accounted
for 13.3 percent of the total in September, down from 78.2
percent in 1991.
This was mainly due to the 1994 deal with the London Club
of commercial creditors for rescheduling and restructuring of
$8.1 billion of foreign debt, BNB said.
A state guarantee applied to 96.8 percent of the long term
debt and to 74.5 percent of the short term debt in September,
said the BNB.
Debt indicators for previous years were also revised
according to the World Bank manual.
